title: Introduction to Modern Statistics (2e) for CRFS
description: A modern introduction to statistics emphasising exploratory data analysis, multivariate relationships, and simulation-based inference. Covers regression modelling, bootstrapping, randomization, and classical inference through the Central Limit Theorem, with updated datasets and exercises throughout. This variant is adapted for CRFS: the examples and context have been changed to fit CRFS work in Africa and the Sahel.
authors: Original by Mine Çetinkaya-Rundel, Johanna Hardin; this variant is for CRFS
subject: general
